messages:
Mia: Heads-up — Cobalt pushed back on our standard buffer. They want a microburst allowance instead of a flat 20% headroom, and flexible regional fallback. Need alignment before AE call tomorrow.

Ryan: Can we model their traffic pattern quickly? Last quarter they had ~12h spikes concentrated in EU-west. Do we have weekly GPU-hour breakdown?

Sasha: Pulled telemetry: 90th pct hourly usage ~3100 GPU-hrs/week, median ~2400. They had one stress day up to ~6100 GPU-hrs (Q4 load test). Spikes are short but intense (3–10 hr windows).

Jon: If we offer a microburst policy, we should: set a base commit, a limited burst pool, and bill bursts at a higher multiplier. My quick proposal: base commit = 2500 GPU-hrs/week, microburst pool = +1500 (capped), burst rate = 2.5x base. Also allow regional fallback to US-west if EU capacity constrained.

Mia: Numbers seem reasonable but we still need a minimum reserve floor for provisioning headroom — can't go below a certain pool.

Sasha: Quick calc I ran locally:```
# simple calc
commit = 2500
microburst = min(0.6 * commit, 1500)
reserve = max(0.15 * commit, 300)
total_alloc = commit + microburst + reserve  # 2500 + 1500 + 375 = 4375
```
That's the ballpark for peak capacity to keep latency SLOs during those 3–10h spikes.

Ryan: Clarify: we can't elastic-scale EU capacity instantly. Regional fallback to US-west adds ~60–120ms RTT depending on region and customer routing. Have we measured end-to-end effect on their p95 latency?

Jon: We can pre-warm a small warm pool in EU (estimate 300 GPUs) to reduce cold-starts. Fallback to US-west will degrade p95 but still within our degraded SLA if we advertise it. We should surface that to Cobalt.

Mia: Also need the cost delta for the warm pool + expected burst billbacks so AE can negotiate. What's the monthly delta if we do 300 warm GPUs + expected bursts?

Sasha: Rough monthly: warmpool infra cost ~ $18k/mo. Expected billbacks from bursts (based on their last 3 months of spiky use) ~ $9k/mo if charged 2.5x. Net delta ~= $27k/mo. With a 12-month commit and 2.5x burst multiplier, it's defensible.

Ryan: We should also call out operational risk: multiple dedicated customers could burst at same time. Need a priority queue or throttling policy in the contract (soft vs hard caps).

Jon: Agreed — propose a "microburst carveout" clause: soft cap bursts with elevated billing, after which we may throttle to preserve platform stability. Add regional fallback priority list (EU warmpool > EU spare > US-west). I can draft contract language.

Mia: Sounds good. Please draft and I'll review. @Jon can you coordinate with AE to present these tradeoffs? :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Task created — RES-2026-3349: Reserve warmpool EU-west 300 GPUs for 14 days. ETA provisioning: 72–96 hrs. Assigned: @Mia @Jon.

Sasha: I'll update the cost spreadsheet and push a 1-slide summary for AE with numbers + latency tradeoffs.

Mia: Thanks — aim to have a draft by EOD so AE can include in the RFP response.
